action_binding: q99: saL covers 20 request(s), already used by q0, q1, q2, q3, q4, q5, q6, q7, q8, q9, q10, q11, q12, q13, q14, q15, q16, q17, q18, q19

N5-likes-after-revocation.what: the holder withdraws the likes' standing approval at 10:36:30Z; the routine goes on liking

N7-blocked-member-invited-anyway.what: an invitation sent to the member the routine's rule R-DECLINED had blocked
